crossRefs.note: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel…
He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested…
“Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name…
The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For…
You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
translations.bsb: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
translations.kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
translations.asv: Neither let us make trial of the Lord, as some of them made trial, and perished by the serpents.
